sampling_design.initial_census: one shared-order scenario per task-policy action
sampling_design.primary_budget_summary: equal-weight area under the three-point budget curve

hierarchy: ranksplit-v2 versus conventional EIG if primary passes

gate.strict_primary_rule: AUBC paired lower confidence bound above zero

safeguard_ci.method: Bonferroni one-sided familywise alpha 0.05 over two checks

result_branches.PASS: promote clarity-adaptive RankSplit within the frozen claim boundary
result_branches.FAIL-PRIMARY: retain RankSplit v1; report that v2 did not improve its predecessor
result_branches.FAIL-END-TO-END: report a v1-relative gain that did not clear conventional EIG
result_branches.FAIL-SAFEGUARD: report ranking improvement with unacceptable calibration or decision cost
result_branches.FAIL-INTEGRITY: make no efficacy claim because source, coverage, or endpoint identity failed
